primary_rule: In at least 70% of stratified cached replays, model MCC must strictly exceed 0.65.
source_checkpoints: one official practice backbone, nine known deployments, no new endpoints
procedure: Sample two distinct prompts uniformly from each of five categories. For each endpoint/prompt sample one of the three archived real replies uniformly; blind endpoint IDs, shuffle rows.
checks: identical paired pass counts, replay manifests and summary metrics for research and packaged code in both runs
